result:
I’d make it impossible to treat another person as an abstraction.

Not forced agreement, not enforced kindness—just a world where, once you truly saw someone’s inner life, you couldn’t unsee it. You could still disagree, still walk away, still be angry. But you couldn’t pretend they were less real than you.

Most cruelty runs on that distance. If it collapsed, a lot of the world would have to rebuild itself around something better.
